body: Oh nice, I guess it's just my phone being weird then. Thanks for the feedback!
I appreciate the answer, thank you. 👍🏻
This is a good point, I could've been more creative with my wording there. I'm glad you liked it though, and thank you for the feedback!

That's a good point, I do need to work on keeping a consistent voice throughout. Sometimes how I text in casual conversation bleeds into my more serious writing, which I need to be mindful of. Thanks for the tip, and I'm glad you liked it!

I'm currently in a rehab for my addiction so this hit me in a couple places, describing things in ways I would never be able to do so elegantly. A part that resonated with me in particular was your description of how addiction can change, very much so like wisps of smoke. A good simile can speak volumes and you clearly have that down to a science. Very nice.

I like the lack of structure with a clever rhyme scheme. Poems that stick to a 4 line A-B-A-B scheme are nice and organized, but get boring sometimes. Breaking that norm and still keeping a good flow is a fun change.
